title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of State Security, and the Ministry of Justice on Issuing the Opinions on Establishing a Criminal Record System for Offenders
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate, Ministry of Public Security, Ministry of State Security, Ministry of Justice

Circular on Issuing the Opinions on Establishing a Criminal Record System for Offenders

Fa Fa [2012] No. 10

To: Higher People's Courts, People's Procuratorates, Public Security Departments (Bureaus), State Security Departments (Bureaus), and Justice Departments (Bureaus) of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; Military Courts of the People's Liberation Army, Military Procuratorates; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, the People's Procuratorate of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, the Public Security Bureau, the State Security Bureau, and the Justice Bureau of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

For the purpose of strengthening and innovating social management measures for special populations, in accordance with the overall deployment of the Central Government regarding the deepening of the judicial system and working mechanism reform, and on the basis of in-depth investigation, research, and broadly soliciting opinions from all parties, the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of State Security, and the Ministry of Justice have jointly formulated the Opinions on Establishing a Criminal Record System for Offenders, which are hereby issued for your earnest implementation. For any issues arising during implementation, please report them in a timely manner to the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of State Security, and the Ministry of Justice respectively.

May 10, 2012

Opinions on Establishing a Criminal Record System for Offenders

A criminal record is an objective record of the circumstances of offenders kept by specialized state organs. The criminal record system is an important component of the modern social management system. To meet the needs of economic and social development in the new era, further promote social management innovation, maintain social stability, and promote social harmony, the following opinions are now put forward regarding the establishment of China's criminal record system for offenders.

I. Significant Meaning and Basic Requirements for Establishing a Criminal Record System for Offenders

Establishing a criminal record system for offenders, which involves the reasonable registration and effective management of offender information, not only helps relevant state departments to fully grasp and utilize offender information, formulate and adjust criminal policies and other public policies in a timely manner, improve and perfect relevant laws and regulations, effectively prevent and control crime, and maintain social order, but also helps to protect the legitimate rights of persons with criminal records and assist them in smoothly reintegrating into society.

In recent years, significant progress has been made in the work of criminal records for offenders in China, and relevant departments have actively explored the establishment of a criminal record system for offenders. Carefully summarizing and promoting the beneficial practices therein, and carrying out the registration and management of offender information nationwide, gradually establishing and perfecting the criminal record system, is of great significance for judicial work to serve the overall situation, promote the resolution of social conflicts, and advance the innovation of social management mechanisms.

The establishment of a criminal record system for offenders and the carrying out of work related to criminal records shall, in accordance with the overall requirements of deeply implementing the Scientific Outlook on Development and building a socialist harmonious society, and within the overall framework of the reform of the judicial system and working mechanisms, fully implement the criminal policy of combining leniency with severity, promote social harmony and stability, and promote the healthy development of the economy and society. It shall be based on national conditions, fully consider the current stage of China's economic and social development and the ideology of the masses, and pay attention to the connection with existing laws, regulations, and other systems. It shall fully recognize the current situation that China's criminal record system and related work are still in the initial stage, focus on key points, advance gradually, ensure that this work can be carried out in a stable and orderly manner, and create conditions for further perfecting China's criminal record system and improving the working mechanism for criminal records.

II. Main Contents of the Criminal Record System for Offenders

(1) Establishment of an Offender Information Database

To strengthen the effective management of offender information, relying on the existing networks and resources of political and legal organs, the public security organs, state security organs, people's procuratorates, and judicial administrative organs shall respectively establish relevant record information databases and achieve interconnection and intercommunication. When conditions mature, a unified national criminal information database shall be established.

The information entered by the offender information registration organ shall include the following: basic information of the offender, the name of the procuratorial organ (private prosecutor) and the adjudicative organ, the number of the judgment document, the date of the judgment, the charge, the sentence imposed, and the status of execution of the sentence, among others.

(2) Establishment of an Offender Information Notification Mechanism

People's courts shall promptly notify the offender information registration organ of effective criminal judgment documents and other relevant information.

Prisons and detention centers shall promptly send the "Notice of Release upon Completion of Sentence" to the offender information registration organ at the place of domicile of the released person.

County-level judicial administrative organs shall promptly send the "Notice of Completion of Correctional Supervision for Community-based Offenders" to the offender information registration organ at the place of domicile of the person whose correctional supervision has been terminated.

When state organs, due to the needs of case handling, inquire about relevant criminal information from the offender information registration organ, the relevant organ shall cooperate.

(3) Regulation of the Offender Information Inquiry Mechanism

The public security organs, state security organs, people's procuratorates, and judicial administrative organs shall respectively be responsible for accepting, reviewing, and processing applications for inquiries into criminal records.

When providing criminal information inquiry services to the public, the aforementioned organs shall strictly act in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations regarding qualifications and conditions for school admission, military enlistment, employment, etc.

If a defense lawyer, in order to fulfill his/her defense duties in accordance with the law, requests to inquire about the criminal records of the suspect or defendant in the case, such request shall be permitted, except where the criminal record of a juvenile has been sealed by law enforcement authorities in accordance with the law.

(4) Establishment of a System for Sealing Juvenile Criminal Records

To deeply implement the Party and the state's policy of "education, persuasion, and redemption" and the principle of "education as the mainstay, punishment as a supplement" for juvenile delinquents, and to effectively assist misguided youth in reintegrating into society, in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law and in light of the actual circumstances of China's juvenile protection work, a system for sealing juvenile minor criminal records is established. For the criminal records of juveniles who were under the age of 18 at the time of the crime and were sentenced to a fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years, such records shall be sealed. After the criminal record is sealed, it shall not be provided to any unit or individual, except where the judicial authorities require it for case handling purposes or where relevant units conduct inquiries in accordance with state regulations. Units that conduct inquiries in accordance with the law shall keep the information of the sealed criminal records confidential.

Law enforcement authorities may retain the criminal records of juveniles as work records.

(5) Clarification of Liability for Handling Offender Information in Violation of Regulations

Departments responsible for providing offender information and their staff shall promptly and accurately provide relevant information to the offender information registration organ. Failure to provide information in accordance with regulations, or intentionally providing false or forged information, if the circumstances are serious or cause serious consequences, shall result in the investigation of the responsibility of the relevant personnel in accordance with the law.

Departments responsible for registering and managing offender information and their staff shall diligently register and properly manage offender information. Failure to register offender information or provide inquiry services in accordance with regulations, or disclosure of offender information in violation of regulations, if the circumstances are serious or cause serious consequences, shall result in the investigation of the responsibility of the relevant personnel in accordance with the law.

Units and individuals using offender information shall use the relevant information in accordance with the purpose of the inquiry and shall keep the offender information confidential. Use of offender information not in accordance with regulations, if the circumstances are serious or cause serious consequences, shall result in the investigation of the responsibility of the relevant personnel in accordance with the law.

III. Steadily Promoting the Establishment and Improvement of the Criminal Record System for Offenders

The criminal record system is a new legal system in China. During its establishment and implementation, various problems and difficulties will inevitably be encountered. Relevant departments must attach great importance to it, organize it carefully, implement it earnestly, and, in light of the nature and characteristics of their own work, study and formulate specific implementation measures or detailed implementation rules, proceed step by step, continuously improve and perfect in practice, and ensure effective results.

The establishment of the criminal record system is a systematic project. All relevant departments shall strengthen coordination, cooperate with each other, and properly handle various problems that may arise during the start-up and advancement of the work. We shall make full use of the political and legal network and the existing network infrastructure of various departments, gradually realize the online entry, inquiry, and document transfer of offender information, and achieve the sharing of offender information. We shall properly handle the relationship between offender information and information on persons subjected to re-education through labor, public security administrative penalties, non-prosecution, and other information databases. We shall summarize in a timely manner, adjust work ideas and methods as appropriate, ensure the smooth development of criminal record work, and promote the development and improvement of China's criminal record system.
